before: A legacy VML text box with no DrawingML alternative was no drawing atom: its shape was dropped, its story was not laid out, and Find and the editor could not reach its text. Floating v:line shapes, stroked rectangles, and shapes with aligned positions or extra inert style keys were dropped.
after: A supported VML text box is one drawing atom of its paragraph, like a DrawingML text box. Its story lays out inside the shape, Find reaches it, and a body box takes text editing through the existing text-box frame scope. Floating lines, stroked and rounded rectangles, and aligned VML positions render. The VML shape itself refuses drawing operations.
reason: Story edits are the existing paragraph text, run, and split operations on w:txbxContent paragraphs in the owner part, which released participants already synchronize for DrawingML text boxes. No operation, stored field, identity, or repair rule changes. The projection is read-only and derived locally from the shared tree. As for earlier projection subset changes, a published selection after a newly supported VML atom can differ by one offset between versions.
